rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something pleasant or satisfying to the senses or mind.

example.english: This hot tea is agreeable to drink.
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 jit6 caa4 jam2 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this for a person whose manner is pleasant and easy to get along with.

example.english: Ming is agreeable, and you can hit it off with him even when you first meet him.
example.traditional: 阿明好相處，第一次見面都傾得埋。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 hou2 soeng1 cyu3 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6 dou1 king1 dak1 maai4

rows.note: Use this when something is agreeable or pleasant-looking to the eye.

example.english: The color scheme of this painting is agreeable to the eye.
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 waa2 ge3 pui3 sik1 hou2 seon6 ngaan5
